PermissionSet.description: Grants edit access to the Touch Level override fields on Opportunity (Touch_Level__c, Touch_Level_Override__c, Touch_Level_Override_By__c, Touch_Level_Override_Date__c, Touch_Level_Override_Reason__c) so Deal Desk can process manual Touch Level overrides. Deliberately excludes the 6 system-calculated Touch Level fields (Touch_Level_Calculated__c, Touch_Level_Calculation_Stage__c, Touch_Level_Criteria_Matched__c, Touch_Level_Last_Calculated__c, Business_Unit__c, Multi_BU_Flag__c), which remain automation-only. Relies on base Opportunity Edit access granted elsewhere (e.g. Opportunity_Update_PS).
PermissionSet.label: Opportunity Touch Level Override PS
